source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of amines (PDF 120-122).

items: Halogenoalkanes aur ammonia se (nucleophilic substitution): CH3CH2Br + NH3 -> CH3CH2NH2 + HBr, ethanol mein zaid ammonia aur pressure ke saath, taa ke secondary amines ya mixture na bane. Ammonia zyada ho to asal product primary amine; halogenoalkane zyada ho to tertiary amine.
Nitriles ko H2/Ni ya LiAlH4 se reduce kar ke: CH3CH2CN + 4[H] -> CH3CH2CH2NH2 (propanenitrile se propan-1-amine).
Nitroalkanes ko LiAlH4 se reduce kar ke: CH3CH2NO2 + 6[H] -> CH3CH2NH2 + 2H2O.
Amides ko LiAlH4 se reduce kar ke, achhi miqdar mein: CH3CONH2 + 4[H] -> CH3CH2NH2 + H2O.
Hofmann reaction se, jo amide se aik carbon kam wala amine deta hai: CH3CONH2 + Br2 + 4NaOH -> CH3NH2 + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) + NH3 (zaid), teer ke oopar ethanol aur neeche High pressure, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + HBr.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-C triple bond N (propanenitrile) + 4[H], teer ke oopar LiAlH4, se CH3-CH2-CH2-NH2 (propan-1-amine).
blocks.caption: Propanenitrile ki reduction se propan-1-amine (kitab ke PDF safha 120 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-NO2 (nitroethane) + 3H2, teer ke oopar LiAlH4, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Nitroethane ki reduction se ethanamine (kitab ke PDF safha 120 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 (ethanamide) + 4[H], teer ke oopar LiAlH4 aur neeche H2O/H+, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki reduction se ethanamine (kitab ke PDF safha 121 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do satron mein Hofmann reaction: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + Br2 + 4NaOH se CH3-NH2 + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ka Hofmann reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 121 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Primary amines ki alkylation se: halogenoalkane ko primary amine ke saath ethanol mein pressure par (band tube mein) garam kar ke: CH3CH2Br + CH3NH2 -> CH3CH2NHCH3 + HBr.
N-substituted amides ki reduction se: CH3CONHCH3 + 4[H] -> CH3CH2NHCH3 + H2O.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) + CH3-NH2, teer ke oopar ethanol, se CH3-CH2-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamine) + HBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane se methanamine ki alkylation (kitab ke PDF safha 121 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamide) + 2H2, teer ke oopar Ni/Pt, se CH3-CH2-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamine) + H2O.
blocks.caption: N-methylethanamide ki reduction se N-methylethanamine (kitab ke PDF safha 121 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne N-methylethanamide ki reduction '+ H2' (Ni/Pt) se likhi aur paani nahi dikhaya; yeh balance nahi hota. C=O ka oxygen paani (H2O) ban kar nikalta hai, is liye do H2 molecules chahiye: CH3CONHCH3 + 2H2 -> CH3CH2NHCH3 + H2O. List mein yahi baat 4[H] se likhi hai (4[H] = 2H2).

items: Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis se: C6H5Cl + 2NH3 -> C6H5NH2 + NH4Cl (Cu2O, 250 C, 50 atm).
Nitrobenzene ki reduction se: C6H5NO2 + 6[H] -> C6H5NH2 + 2H2O (Sn aur garha HCl).
Benzamide ke Hofmann reaction se: C6H5CONH2 + Br2 + 4NaOH -> C6H5NH2 + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.

blocks.alt: Chlorobenzene (Cl wali benzene ring) + 2NH3, teer ke oopar Cu2O aur neeche 250 darje C, 50 atm, se phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + NH4Cl.
blocks.caption: Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis se phenylamine (kitab ke PDF safha 121 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene (NO2 wali ring) + 6[H], teer ke oopar Sn + garha HCl, se phenyl amine (aniline) (NH2 wali ring) + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Nitrobenzene ki reduction se phenyl amine (kitab ke PDF safha 122 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do satron mein Hofmann reaction: benzamide (C(=O)-NH2 wali ring) + Br2 + 4NaOH se phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Benzamide ka Hofmann reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 122 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Chloromethylbenzene, C6H5CH2Cl, se 2-phenylethanamine, C6H5CH2CH2NH2 (chocolate ka 'feel good factor'), banane ka tareeqa batayein.
blocks.explanation: C6H5CH2Cl ko ethanol mein KCN ke saath reflux par garam kar ke C6H5CH2CN (aik carbon zyada) banayein, phir nitrile ko LiAlH4 (ya H2/Ni) se reduce karein: C6H5CH2CN + 4[H] -> C6H5CH2CH2NH2.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa nitro compound, nitrile aur amide reduction par (i) primary amine (CH3)2CHCH2NH2 aur (ii) secondary amine CH3CH2CH2CH2NHCH3 dete hain?
blocks.explanation: (i) Nitro compound (CH3)2CHCH2NO2; nitrile (CH3)2CHCN; amide (CH3)2CHCONH2. (ii) Nitro compounds ya nitriles ki reduction sirf primary amines deti hai, is liye sirf amide kaam karta hai: CH3CH2CH2CONHCH3 (N-methylbutanamide).

items: Primary: RX + zaid NH3; nitriles, nitro compounds ya amides ki reduction; Hofmann (aik C kam).
Secondary: RX + primary amine; N-substituted amides ki reduction.
Phenylamine: chlorobenzene + NH3, ya nitrobenzene ki reduction (Sn/HCl).
